title: Error provenance & retry visibility — unified dashboard and tracing hooks
creator: Arjun Rao
description: Goal: provide a single-pane observability view that attributes request failures to a concise provenance chain (client retry loop, gateway, routing, model variant, runtime kernel) and shows retry behavior impact on SLOs. Deliver a dashboard + tracehook enrichment that: 1) classifies failures into taxonomy buckets (timeout, overload, model-error, reject, http/gRPC status mapping), 2) surfaces retry loops and duplicate work (client vs platform retries), 3) correlates retry counts with tail latency and token cost, 4) adds an interactive drilldown from dashboard to a pre-filtered trace/capture with enriched span attributes (retry_reason, backend_node, model_id, qtype, kv_cache_hit, backlog_ms).
acceptance_criteria: Unified dashboard shows failure volume and rate by taxonomy bucket and by endpoint/model over last 7/30d
Dashboard rows include retry amplification metric (ratio of retries per failed request) and cost delta estimate
Tracehook enrichment populates span attributes: retry_origin, retry_reason, model_variant, kv_cache_status, queue_time_ms
Sampling policy retains 100% traces for requests that cross retry amplification threshold and 1-2% baseline otherwise
Runbook entries auto-surface top-3 mitigations for each taxonomy bucket (timeout tuning, autoscale policy, model throttling, client backoff)
